claims: The 2026 WNBA Draft took place on Monday, April 13, 2026.
The 2026 WNBA Draft took place at 7 p.m. ET.
The 2026 WNBA Draft was held at The Shed at Hudson Yards in New York City.
The 2026 WNBA Draft was broadcast on ESPN.
The Dallas Wings selected UConn's Azzi Fudd as the No. 1 overall pick.
The Minnesota Lynx selected Olivia Miles as the No. 2 overall pick.
